newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SAVINGS WITHDRAWS APPLICATION FOR SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: SAVINGS WITHDRAWS APPLICATION FOR SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: The securities commission said on Monday that Lithuanian Savings Bank had withdrawn its application for a six million litas share issue.

"The central bank did not approve of the announcement of the issue of six million litas worth of shares," Rita Vidugiriene, a Savings Bank official, told Reuters. "Therefore it was decided to postpone this announcement."
Vidugiriene said the central bank did not say why it did not give its approval, only that it was waiting for audit results at the state-owned bank.
Savings Bank has a share capital of 60 million litas and reported an unaudited 10 million litas loss for the first half of 1997 after posting a 30 million litas net profit for 1996.
